points.description: States that the statement is FALSE.

Justifies the verdict: each process is an independent entity that needs its own separate OS state (its own PCB or process-control record) to track its execution, memory, open files and stack, so one PCB shared by all instances with a reference counter cannot provide this. Equivalent wording and any correct reason that separate instances need separate state earn the marks.

rubric.notes: The verdict is worth half a mark. The justification is worth the remaining 1.5 marks and is required for any marks, per the question's rule that no correct justification means no marks. Full marks need FALSE plus a reason that each process needs its own separate state. Naming a shared PCB as wrong without explaining independent per-process state is not enough for P2.
